_backend = None

        name = tool.name

            async def forward(**kwargs):
                result = await _backend.call_tool(tool_name, kwargs)
                if result.content:
                    content = result.content[0]
                    return content.text if hasattr(content, 'text') else str(content)
                return None
            return forward
        
        handler = await make_tool(name)
        proxy.tool(description=tool.description or "")(handler)
    
    resources = await _backend.list_resources()
    for resource in resources.resources:
        uri = resource.uri
        
        async def make_resource(resource_uri: str):
            async def forward():
                result = await _backend.read_resource(resource_uri)
                if result.contents:
                    content = result.contents[0]
                    return content.text if hasattr(content, 'text') else str(content)
                return None
            return forward
        
        handler = await make_resource(uri)
        proxy.resource(uri_template=uri, description=resource.description or "")(handler)

    cmd = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "python"
